items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Herb was interviewed by Michael Woods in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995.

ctx.x: Herb Ellis demonstrates the idea of “minimum effort, maximum results.” His melodic guitar playing has been an integral part of numerous classic jazz recordings, especially with the renown Oscar Peterson Trio of the 1950s. He was born in Texas in 1921, graduated from North Texas State, and found inspiration from Charlie Christian, another Texas guitarist. Herb was interviewed by Michael Woods in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995.

We are here today at the Marriott in Los Angeles filming interviews for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. We have with us today one of the world’s most outstanding jazz guitarists, Herb Ellis. Pleased to meet you.
